_comment: Scoped permissions for unattended loop.sh runs in THIS repo only.
It grants exactly what an iteration needs and nothing more, so you do NOT have to
reach for PERMISSION_MODE=bypassPermissions, which approves everything including
Bare `dotnet` on this Mac resolves to /usr/local/share/dotnet, which CANNOT see
the .NET 10 SDK installed at ~/.dotnet. Every build command must use the absolute
path ~/.dotnet/dotnet. Both forms are allowed below so a stray bare call still
works, but the spec's verification array uses the absolute path deliberately.
Review this list. Anything you are not comfortable with an agent running
unsupervised in this directory should be deleted from it.
